items.html: And with this you will understand how there are male people who come from the Gevurot, which is the name BaN. The matter is that they are from MaH of BaN, and their females are from BaN of BaN, inferior to them. And there are males from MaH of MaH, and females from BaN of MaH, inferior to them. But relative to the general MaH and the general BaN, there is a great advantage to the general BaN over the general MaH, since the name BaN is the aspect of SaG, and it is higher than MaH, as explained in another book, in the matter of the kings, that they are from SaG. And this is the matter of Arich Anpin: his right shoulder is the Hasadim from the general MaH, and his left shoulder is the Gevurot from the general BaN; and these are the Daat of ZA.
